name: Haust Basemaps
requires: MapLibre GL JS with the PMTiles protocol registered (pmtiles >= 3)

topographic.name: Haust Topographic
topographic.use: General reference map. Use when the basemap itself is the content or no other choice is stated.

canvas.name: Haust Canvas
canvas.use: Quiet neutral ground. Use under thematic overlays: choropleths, dot maps, heat maps, routes.

atlas.name: Haust Atlas
atlas.use: Printed historical-atlas look. Use for narrative and historical maps with a few routes or points on top.

dark.name: Haust Dark
dark.use: Dark ground. Use for dashboards, live desks and anything shown on a dark page.

anchors.haust-below-roads: Insert area overlays (choropleths, washes, rasters) here: above land, water and buildings, below roads and labels.
anchors.haust-below-labels: Insert line and point overlays here: above roads, below every label.
